mapper.select: SELECT P.PROJECT_ID, P.PROJECT_NAME, P.END_DATE, P.PM_USER_ID, P.PL_USER_ID, AVG(NVL(T.PROGRESS_RATE,0)) AS PROGRESS_RATE FROM PROJECTS P JOIN TASKS T ON P.PROJECT_ID = T.PROJECT_ID GROUP BY P.PROJECT_ID, P.PROJECT_NAME, P.END_DATE, P.PM_USER_ID, P.PL_USER_ID ORDER BY P.PROJECT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROJECTS ( PROJECT_ID, PARENT_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_BY, PM_USER_ID, PL_USER_ID, EDITOR_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{parentProjectId}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{isPublic}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{pmUserId}, #{plUserId}, #{editorUserId} )
